# Pritesh Rathod

> Python Backend Developer specializing in FastAPI, LangChain, and LangGraph. Building scalable backend systems and AI/LLM-powered applications.

## About

Pritesh Rathod is a Python Backend Developer with a growing focus on AI systems and production-ready applications. He is currently pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Applications & Information Technology at Gujarat University, and specializes in building scalable backend solutions using FastAPI, LangChain, and LangGraph. His recent work has focused on RAG pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI platforms such as Zentriom, where he combined multiple AI tools into a single product. He is based in Ahmedabad, India.

## Projects

### AI Voice Assistant
Web-based AI voice assistant that understands natural language commands. Built with SvelteKit, FastAPI, Python, NLP (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), and the Web Speech API.
GitHub: https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/ai-voice-assistant

### BuildTrack: Construction Management System
A role-based construction management system that digitizes project planning, attendance tracking, cost estimation, and reporting, improving transparency and efficiency across admins, members, and clients. Built with Flask, Python, MySQL, and Bootstrap.
GitHub: https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/BuildTrack-construction-management-system

### Netflix Watchlist API
RESTful API built with Go and MongoDB for managing a movie watchlist. Supports CRUD operations, watch status updates, and ObjectID handling using a clean MVC-style architecture. Built with Go, MongoDB, Python, Gorilla Mux.
GitHub: https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/go-mongodb-crud-api

### Medical RAG Chatbot
AI medical chatbot using Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Pinecone vector search, and Groq LLM for accurate health Q&A. Built with Python, LangChain, Pinecone, Groq, LLaMA 3, Sentence Transformers.
GitHub: https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/end-to-end-medical-chatbot-generative-ai
